notes.title: Announcing Remastered Version of Insurgence 1 & 2
notes.notes:
Platomenti Studios and YSY Softworks partnered with CRX Entertainment Pte Ltd are pleased to announce the upcoming release of the Remastered version of Insurgence - Chains of Renegade and Insurgence - Second Assault.

The Remastered version of these two games is set to feature a brand new pixel rendering engine, providing players with even more vibrant and rich colors than ever before, bringing these games to life in a whole new way. In addition, the games will be localized to more languages, with more details on which languages to come soon.

For Insurgence - Chains of Renegade, the game will also feature all new music from SSCore, a music production studio from YSY Softworks. This in-house music production studio has collaborated with Platomenti Studios for this release, providing an entirely new soundtrack for players to enjoy as they progress through the game.

"We're thrilled to bring these two beloved games back to the forefront with the Remastered version," said a spokesperson for Platomenti Studios. "With the new pixel rendering engine and the addition of more languages, we're confident that players will love the new look and feel of the game. And with the all-new music from SSCore, we're confident that both new and returning players will have an unforgettable experience."

The Remastered version of Insurgence - Chains of Renegade and Insurgence - Second Assault will be available on PC, with a Steam release planned for the near future. The Steam page is now up for Wishlist, so fans of the series can show their support and stay up-to-date with the latest news on the upcoming release.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2327370/Insurgence__Chains_of_Renegade_Remastered/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2327380/Insurgence__Second_Assault_Remastered/


For more information on the Remastered version of Insurgence - Chains of Renegade and Insurgence - Second Assault, please visit the official website of Platomenti Studios or follow their social media pages.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 - Graphics Freeze Fix
notes.notes:
Changelog:
- Fixed the graphics freeze issue.
- Fixed some incorrect fast travel location descriptions.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4 - Skill Level Up Fix
notes.notes:
Changelog
- Fixed the issue where certain skills don't level up when used from the menu.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Changelog:
- Fixed the issue with certain characters' skills and equipment not carrying over upon starting New Game+.
- Fixed some incorrect equipment stats.
- Fixed the issue with players not being able to fast travel to Chilling Tundra Gateway from Chilling Tundra Campfire.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Changelog:
- Fixed the issue where save files don't display the correct difficulty setting.
(After this update, old save files may display "0" in place of the difficulty, but it will return to the correct difficulty after saving the game.)
- Fixed the issue where the player doesn't get the "Swordmaster" achievement if the player does not accept the swordsman's challenge at first.
(For players who have defeated the swordsman before this update and have not obtained the Swordmaster achievement, simply walk into the area the swordsman was in, and you should get the achievement.)

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 - QoL Update
notes.notes:
Changelog:
- Added "Quit" option to the title menu.
- Enemies will no longer chase the player in areas that are already cleared.
